## Summary
This PR finishes the Batch 1 wire rename for the eight packages 607B did not cover: `dashboard/`, `activity/`, `comment/`, `budget/`, `task/`, `document/`, `mywork/` and `calendar/`. REST paths and JSON record names and components move from `project`/`customer` to `matter`/`client`. Entities, tables, services, audit literals and EntityTag literals are unchanged (ADR-337/342). There are no `@JsonProperty`/`@JsonAlias` annotations and no migration. The backend now returns 404 for the old paths, with no redirects (§12.4.7). The `WireVocabularyContractTest` ratchet goes from 55 to 4 entries.

## Changes
**Paths**

| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/health` | `GET /api/matters/{matterId}/health` |
| `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/task-summary` | `GET /api/matters/{matterId}/task-summary` |
| `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/member-hours` | `GET /api/matters/{matterId}/member-hours` |
| `GET /api/dashboard/project-health` | `GET /api/dashboard/matter-health` |
| `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/activity` | `GET /api/matters/{matterId}/activity` |
| `GET,POST /api/projects/{projectId}/comments`, `PUT,DELETE …/comments/{commentId}` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/comments[/{commentId}]` (Location header updated) |
| `GET,PUT,DELETE /api/projects/{projectId}/budget`, `GET …/budget/status` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/budget[/status]` |
| `GET,POST /api/projects/{projectId}/tasks` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/tasks` |
| `GET /api/projects/{projectId}/documents`, `POST …/documents/upload-init` | `/api/matters/{matterId}/documents[/upload-init]` |

Unchanged: `/api/tasks/**`, `/api/documents/**`, `/api/dashboard/{kpis,team-workload,personal,activity}`, `/api/my-work/**`, `/api/calendar`, `/api/customers/{customerId}/documents/upload-init` (608B).

**Records**

| Old | New |
|---|---|
| `dashboard.dto.ProjectHealth{projectId, projectName, customerName}` | `MatterHealth{matterId, matterName, clientName}` |
| `ProjectHealthDetail` / `ProjectHealthMetrics` | `MatterHealthDetail` / `MatterHealthMetrics` (no component changes) |
| `ProjectBreakdownEntry{projectId, projectName}` | `MatterBreakdownEntry{matterId, matterName}` |
| `ProjectHoursEntry{projectId, projectName}` | `MatterHoursEntry{matterId, matterName}` |
| `CrossProjectActivityItem{projectId, projectName}` | `CrossMatterActivityItem{matterId, matterName}` |
| `KpiResponse.activeProjectCount`, `KpiValues.activeProjectCount` | `activeMatterCount` |
| `PersonalDashboard.projectBreakdown` | `matterBreakdown` |
| `UpcomingDeadline.projectName` | `matterName` |
| `BudgetStatus.projectId`, `BudgetStatusResponse.projectId` | `matterId` (class names kept) |
| `CommentResponse.projectId`, `TaskResponse.projectId`, `DocumentResponse.projectId` | `matterId` |
| `MyWorkTaskItem`, `MyWorkTimeEntryItem` `{projectId, projectName}` | `{matterId, matterName}` |
| `MyWorkProjectSummary{projectId, projectName}` | `MyWorkMatterSummary{matterId, matterName}` |
| `MyWorkTimeSummaryResponse.byProject` | `byMatter` |
| `CalendarService.CalendarItemDto{projectId, projectName}`, `itemType "PROJECT"` | `{matterId, matterName}`, `itemType "MATTER"` (record name kept) |

**Forced edit outside the packages:** `mcp/dto/McpDocumentDto.from()` now calls `doc.matterId()` (accessor only). `McpDocumentDto`'s own components `projectId`/`customerId` are unchanged, and `tool-contract.json` is byte-identical.

### Downstream impact: 607D must follow (frontend)
- **Paths:** every path in the table above.
- **JSON fields:**
  - `matterId` on task responses, including `PATCH /api/tasks/{id}/complete`. That response unwraps `TaskResponse` with `@JsonUnwrapped`, so `nextInstance.matterId` changes too.
  - `matterId` on comment, document and budget-status responses.
  - Dashboard:
    - `activeMatterCount` and `previousPeriod.activeMatterCount` on `/api/dashboard/kpis`
    - `matterBreakdown[].{matterId,matterName}` and `upcomingDeadlines[].matterName` on `/api/dashboard/personal`
    - `{matterId,matterName,clientName}` on `/api/dashboard/matter-health`
    - `{matterId,matterName}` on `/api/dashboard/activity`
  - **Team workload:** `/api/dashboard/team-workload` keeps the outer `projects` field, but its items are now `{matterId, matterName, hours}`.
  - **My work:**
    - `assigned[]/unassigned[].{matterId,matterName}` on `/api/my-work/tasks`
    - `{matterId,matterName}` on `/api/my-work/time-entries`
    - `byMatter[].{matterId,matterName}` on `/api/my-work/time-summary`
  - **Calendar:** `items[].{matterId,matterName}`, and `itemType` emits `"MATTER"`. The `?type=` filter now accepts `MATTER` and rejects `PROJECT` with 400. Frontend files to update: `calendar-types.ts`, `calendar-page-client.tsx`, `calendar-month-view.tsx`.
- **Not changed:** query params `?projectId=` on `/api/my-work/tasks` and `/api/calendar`; `DocumentResponse.customerId`; document `scope` values; comment `entityType` values.
